description: Source code for mod_authn_ldap, an LDAP backend module for HTTP authentication in the lighttpd server. Implements LDAP connection handling, user DN retrieval, and group membership verification.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_init
methods.description: Initializes the LDAP authentication backend module, registers the backend handler.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_free
methods.description: Frees resources allocated by the module, unbinds LDAP connections.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into the module's plugin_config structure.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_merge_config
methods.description: Merges a set of configuration plugin values into the module's plugin_config.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_patch_config
methods.description: Creates a per-request configuration by merging defaults and applicable global configs.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_err
methods.description: Logs LDAP errors with detailed messages.

methods.name: mod_authn_append_ldap_dn_escape
methods.description: Escapes LDAP DN attribute values according to RFC4514.

methods.name: mod_authn_append_ldap_filter_escape
methods.description: Escapes LDAP filter assertion values according to RFC4515.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_host_init
methods.description: Initializes an LDAP connection with proper options and TLS if configured.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_bind
methods.description: Performs LDAP bind with provided credentials.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_rebind_proc
methods.description: Rebind procedure used during LDAP searches for re-establishing connection.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_search
methods.description: Performs LDAP search with given base and filter, handles reconnects.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_get_dn
methods.description: Retrieves the distinguished name (DN) of a user based on a filter.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_memberOf
methods.description: Checks group membership of a user via LDAP search.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_basic
methods.description: Main handler for LDAP basic authentication, performs user DN lookup, bind, and group checks.

methods.name: mod_authn_ldap_plugin_init
methods.description: Registers the plugin with the server, setting version, name, and lifecycle functions.
